thread:
maria.cho: Quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from the 3/19 inference spike. Need owners for: alert dedupe audit, suppression windows, and paging policy tweaks. Who can own what?

daniel: I can own the dedupe rule audit. Will run historical sim and propose rule changes. ETA EOW.

sarah: I can take suppression windows & paging policy. I'll draft proposed thresholds + debounce logic.

ops-bot: [bot] Created ticket INF-4321 and linked the postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321

maria.cho: thanks — please add owners and target dates in the ticket. Also add a short runbook section for on-call.

daniel: plan: run historical dedupe sim over last 30d -> compute FP reduction vs missed incidents. Command I used locally:
```
python infra/simulate_dedupe.py --window=60 --group-by='route,error_code,customer_tier' --lookback=30
```
I'll attach the csv results.

sarah: paging draft: only page if p99 latency > 2s sustained for 3m AND >3 distinct nodes showing high load. Suppression window: start at 5m for noisy routes, then 30m for known noisy customers. Debounce: 2m. Thoughts?

daniel: +1 on grouping keys. Also we should ensure dedupe respects customer_tier so premium customers still get pages. Might add override tag.

maria.cho: action items:
- daniel -> INF-4321.1: dedupe audit + sim results (due 2026-03-29)
- sarah -> INF-4321.2: suppression/paging proposal + runbook PR (due 2026-03-31)
- calvin -> INF-4321.3: add regression alert to detect big changes in suppressed-alert ratio (due 2026-04-05)

calvin: I'll take the regression alert work. Will get baseline metrics and a dashboard.

remediation-bot: Subtasks created: INF-4321.1 assigned to daniel, INF-4321.2 assigned to sarah, INF-4321.3 assigned to calvin.

maria.cho: ok, please update ticket with short acceptance criteria. Let's reconvene Tue 2026-03-30 11:00 PT for a 30m sync. calendar invite when you have PRs.

daniel: calendar scheduled. sharing draft in INF-4321 comments.

sarah: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/842 ; tagging @maria.cho for review.

calvin: dashboard seeded, sharing link in ticket.

maria.cho: great work, this should cut noise by ~30% if thresholds hold. :thumbsup:
